result.title: NX-3 versus placebo on sleep onset latency in adults with chronic insomnia: a multicenter randomized controlled trial.
result.abstractText: This multicenter randomized controlled trial randomly assigned 240 adults with chronic insomnia to NX-3 or matching placebo for 6 weeks. The primary outcome was sleep onset latency measured by polysomnography. NX-3 shortened sleep onset latency versus placebo.

result.title: NX-3 versus zolpidem in adults with chronic insomnia: a randomized head-to-head trial.
result.abstractText: Adults with chronic insomnia were randomly assigned to NX-3 or zolpidem; no placebo arm was included. Sleep latency was measured by polysomnography. Both treatments reduced sleep latency, with no significant difference between arms.

result.title: NX-3 versus placebo for chronic insomnia: a quasi-randomized trial.
result.abstractText: Sixty adults with chronic insomnia were allocated to NX-3 or placebo by alternation. Sleep latency was recorded with sleep diaries over 4 weeks. Allocation was not concealed.

result.title: Bedtime administration of NX-3 versus placebo and sleep latency in adults with chronic insomnia: a randomized controlled trial.
result.abstractText: In this randomized controlled trial, 110 adults with chronic insomnia took NX-3 or placebo at bedtime for 4 weeks. The primary outcome was sleep latency measured by polysomnography.

result.title: NX-3 versus placebo in adults with chronic insomnia and prolonged sleep latency: a randomized controlled trial.
result.abstractText: We enrolled 132 adults with chronic insomnia and baseline sleep latency over 30 minutes in a randomized controlled trial of NX-3 versus placebo. The primary endpoint was sleep latency measured by polysomnography at week 6.
